dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_frost: You're looking at the glass, %1$s. Everyone does. My people were grinding lenses like this before yours had forges. It tells me how strong a thing is before it gets close.
The smith offered me his best mule for this eyepiece. I said I'd make him one the day he can tell me what's inside it. He's still guessing.
Where my people come from the cold never lifts, and none of us would have it any other way. You learn to build well in a place like that. This glass is older than your village.
The ice took the first one, %1$s. This one doesn't feel the cold and it doesn't tire. My aunt built it in an afternoon. Your smiths call it a marvel. We call it a spare.
Go on, knock on it. Everyone wants to. That's Frostborn work. It'll outlast me, and then somebody's grandchild will wear it.
A trader asked what I'd take for the limb. I asked what he'd take for his. We make these for people who need them, not for shelves.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.frost_tec: Have you seen what the Frostborn carry, %1$s? Glass that reads a man's strength. Limbs of metal that grip like flesh. Our smith can't even work out the hinge.
My cousin has a Frostborn-made hand. It works better than the one the saw took. He polishes it on feast days.
If a Frostborn ever offers to mend something of yours, say yes and don't ask how. It won't break again.
I asked the Frostborn here where they learned to build like that. They looked up. Not at the roof, %1$s. Past it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.blood_frost_tec: You keep looking at it. Go on, ask. I don't mind. It's the best work you'll see this side of the sky.
Made it, mended it, and made the tools that made it. We don't trade for what we can build.
Once. My grandfather dropped it off a cliff. It still worked. He didn't.
Looks like a toy to me.
And your sword looks like a sharpened spoon. We'll each keep our own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.frost_tech_want: A pedlar came through with a Frostborn eyeglass. One look and it told him my ox was stronger than me. I'd have paid double for it.
Find a Frostborn and ask nicely.
I did. They said nicely wasn't the price. Wouldn't say what was.
Where do they get such things?
They make them. Ask where they learned and they point at the night sky and laugh.
You can see your ox is stronger without a glass.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.frost_tech_your: You're Frostborn, aren't you? Is it true your people can build an arm that works like a real one?
Ha! I believe it. My brother lost his to the mill. I'll tell him there's hope.
Some of us can. I was raised here.
Ah. Well, it's in the blood somewhere. Give it time.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.starwrights: Kin who kept the old crafts
Your family never let the old crafts go. You grew up among lenses, wire and humming metal, and wore your first eyeglass before you could read.
Raised by kin who kept the old crafts.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wooden_limb.1: Look at this, %1$s. Wood. It creaks when it rains and it swells when it doesn't. The Frostborn make ones that hum.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wooden_limb.2: I'm grateful to have a limb at all. I'd be more grateful for an iron one. I'd weep for one of those Frostborn ones.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wooden_limb.3: The smith's boy carved this. You can tell. He carves spoons the rest of the week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wooden_limb.4: Woodworm, %1$s. In my own limb. A man up the road has a metal one with a little green lamp on it, and I have woodworm.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.wooden_limb.ope: Don't stare at the wood. I know it's wood. It was this or nothing, and some days I think nothing had more dignity.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.wooden_limb.a.s: It does not. But thank you for lying.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.wooden_limb.b: Save up for an iron one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.wooden_limb.b.s: On what I earn? I'd have the money about when I stop needing the limb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.wooden_limb.c: Ask a Frostborn to make you one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.wooden_limb.c.s: I've thought of it. They're proud, though. I'd want to bring something worth their while.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.frost_tech_owne: Frostborn work, this. Took me three harvests and a favour I can't talk about. Worth every bit of both.
Isn't it? I sleep with it under the pillow. Don't tell anyone.
Do you know how it works?
Not a bit. The Frostborn who sold it said I wouldn't need to. She was right.
Then rob me again. I'd pay it twice.
